{{Quote|I strongly advise you to not approach the ruins!|Survey Team leader|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Ruins of Kressh''' were a set of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] ruins located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Athiss/Legends|Athiss]] outside of the [[Tomb of Vodal Kressh|tomb]] of the [[Sith alchemist/Legends|Sith alchemist]] [[Vodal Kressh]]. Those who had served Kressh during his life remained on Athiss in the tomb and ruins and their descendants became known as the [[Tomb Dwellers]]. When [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic survey team six-eight-nine-mark-one|survey team six-eight-nine-mark-one]] landed on Athiss they accidentally discovered the ruins and the tomb and were driven mad before being attacked by the Dwellers. Both the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] then put together strike teams to investigate the area where the survey team had gone missing, and one of the strike teams arrived at the area and [[Mission to Athiss|fought]] their way through the Tomb Dwellers there, including the [[Beast of Vodal Kressh]]. They then moved on into the [[Burial/Legends|tomb]].
